features: terminal hidden128 before enc4 concatenated with actual encoder input126; h1 captured but excluded
fit_objective: equal-network final squared mean residual; sigma squared weights normalized by training mean
score: equal-network mean log final-MSE ratio vs unchanged parent; float64 correction then original max0 and float32 output
selection: same six ridge grid plus zero; target >=0.5% CV; negative below target retained proposal without additional variants
final_fit: once all32 only if CV<=-0.5%; smaller negative proposal reported to root
promotion: CV is training evidence only; independent fresh24 required
